lead_headline: Restaurant closures accelerate with 5 new leads today—Mopoke shutters at Milk Market while China Jade ends 15-year Westwood run

restaurant.blurb: 5 new leads today push active roster to 50 total (24 openings, 26 closures)—Wednesday closure wave includes Mopoke's exit from Denver Milk Market (Union Station poke concept replaced by East3 in Sage Hospitality reshuffle), China Jade Seafood's permanent closure (375 S Federal, 15+ year Westwood dim sum fixture), and Your Mom's House's tax seizure (Capitol Hill venue auctioned by city after 9-year run). Opening side holds steady at 24, but closure leads now outnumber openings for first time since March 15—pattern reversal follows weekend's brief opening-lead advantage. Downtown turnover narrative continues: Mopoke joins C Burger, G-Que, Ogo Korean BBQ in Union Station churn zone.

foreclosure.blurb: 30 filings this week match prior week's floor, confirming March baseline after five-week descent—decline arrested at 30-filing threshold for second consecutive week. 101 auctions scheduled next seven days (up from 39 yesterday), $11.2M aggregate exposure unchanged. Arapahoe's $2.24M South Columbine Circle remains week's sole seven-figure property. County distribution stable: El Paso 475 active cases, Weld 407, Arapahoe 415—exurban concentration persists. Filing trajectory flattened: 0% weekly change indicates March floor discovered at 30-filing rate, aligning with seasonal 2025 comparables.

reputation.blurb: 10 mentions yesterday elevate seven-day total to 42 citations across 11 sources—up 8% from prior week's 39, reversing two-week slide. Denver Post regains share at 38% (16 of 42), Hoodline contributes 6 pickups, social platforms add 12 combined. Notable detections: kosher grocer foreclosure coverage, Curtis Park shelter security story, Governor's Mansion affordable housing development. Yesterday's 10-mention surge (versus 3 Monday) driven by Post breaking news cycle—highest single-day total since March 12. Pattern shift: 39-floor tested last week now rebounding toward 43-45 plateau range. Google News RSS captures 98% discovery (41 of 42).

subscriptions.blurb: Net −1 yesterday (0 new, 1 canceled) trims MTD to +26 (+1.5/day), 90-day cumulative holds +87. Tuesday churn breaks four-day zero-cancellation streak (Mar 13-17), first cancellation since March 12. Seven-day window remains robust at +15 net (19 new, 4 canceled), double prior week's +7—retention discipline sustains gains despite single-day slip. March's 1.5/day rate still tracks 15% above YTD's 1.3/day benchmark. Recent pattern: post-volatility stability (Mar 9-16) absorbed yesterday's churn without momentum collapse—acquisition pace holds near-term floor above 2-4 new/day range.
